description: What the application's own pages may ask of the shell once the window has left the splash for http://127.0.0.1:<port>: opening a web, mailto or tel link in the system's default handler, and nothing else. The opener plugin intercepts every click on a link that opens a new tab (a link in a rendered document or an AI answer) and hands it to open_url; capabilities cover only the local splash by default, so without this grant the click is swallowed and the link does nothing. The shell's own commands and the file opener stay with the splash (default.json). The port is a wildcard because the shell picks a free one at launch.
